entry.title: Conformal Bootstrap Bounds on Graviton Scattering Amplitudes in $\text{AdS}_5 \times S^5$
entry.summary:
Non-perturbative stringy corrections to supergravity amplitudes at finite 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$ are constrained by dispersion relations and crossing symmetry. Combining numerical conformal bootstrap with localization inputs, we pin down the first three higher-derivative Wilson coefficients to within $0.04\%$ across all couplings.

Source: arXiv High-Energy Theory (hep-th) · Tags: #high-energy #quantum-physics
